title: Product column map: logical names to physical names
notApplied: Not applied to any database or environment.
generatedBy: model/generate.mjs. Do not edit by hand: change the model and run "node model/generate.mjs write"

source.modelSha256Note: SHA-256 of the parsed model written back as compact JSON, so line endings do not change it

purpose: Maps every logical entity and column name of the model to its Dataverse schema name and its Azure SQL name. The engine core uses logical names only; adapters use this map (document 25, sections 3.2 and 11.1)

placeholders.<prefix>: The Dataverse publisher prefix, picked with the product name (D-05). tools/rename-product.mjs swaps it
placeholders.Product: The product name placeholder. Stays until the product owner picks the name

naming: Dataverse (document 20, section 3.4): tables and columns are <prefix>_ plus the logical name in PascalCase; a lookup ends with Id; the logical name is the lowercase schema name. The primary key is <prefix>_<Table>Id and the primary name is <prefix>_Name. Created On, Created By, Modified On and Modified By are the built-in columns. Is Active on a configuration table is the platform state (document 22, section 10.1)

Azure SQL (document 20, section 3.5; document 22, section 11.1): schema config for configuration entities, ops for operational entities, audit for O24; tables are the logical name in PascalCase with no prefix; a reference column ends with Id; the primary key is Id

Derived columns that are never stored have no physical column. Taxonomy Label is stored in Name. A column restated by an entity is the same physical column as the column set column (model open point 8)
workingDefaults: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 1). About 20 fixed engine meanings, all labels configurable. Every meaning attribute reads one of these contracts, and a client renames, adds or hides labels only. Here every meaning column maps to a Dataverse choice column and an Azure varchar(32) column with a check constraint. If the answer is no, these columns become references to configuration rows on both bindings.
